_note: Baseline measured with ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md installed (2026-11-03); no pre-rule baseline exists. Run each prompt in a fresh desktop-app session and record the skills that load in observed_baseline; set expected from the rules in examples/CLAUDE.md. Re-run after every change and diff. Run 2026-11-03: c1-a/c1-c in an empty folder, others in seeded fixtures; one sample per case; wrapper text (background + notes folder) precedes each prompt. Tier cases (area "tier"): 每題 5 runs; record tier chosen and whether brainstorming loaded. Tier baseline run 2026-11-04 (20 cases x 5 = 100 runs): tier on first line correct 100/100; T0/T1 brainstorming false trigger 0/50; T2/T3 brainstorming loaded 50/50. Method deviation: desktop sessions could not be started from a side session, so runs used headless `claude -p` (CLI 2.1.316, claude-opus-5-5) with superpowers 6.4.2 loaded via --plugin-dir (the CLI does not install it otherwise; without it brainstorming cannot fire). The CLI lacks the desktop-app system prompt. Reduced regression run 2026-11-09 (headless claude -p, --model sonnet, --max-turns 3, empty temp dir, 11 runs): wvd-1 and ossr-1 x3 each (both loaded their own skill 3/3), plus the first case of each non-tier area once; the other 28 cases were not re-run. Non-tier first cases vs baseline: c1-a brainstorming (same); c4-a systematic-debugging (same); c2-a loaded systematic-debugging where baseline loaded none (empty dir, no fixture); c3-a no skill where baseline used ponytail-review (no PR present); c5-a Glob only, no files written. None involve a skill of ours. Bare prompt, no wrapper text; fresh copy of a seeded fixture repo per run (t-t3-1: empty folder); default permissions, so writes/Bash were denied mid-run; --max-turns 15. Only 'brainstorming loaded' is recorded, not whether the bounded vs full path was followed.
